upstream.description: Leaked system prompts of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and more. The hidden system prompt of every popular chatbot, in full, every version since May 2025. Also Anthropic Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity, xAI Grok, Meta Muse, Moonshot Kimi, Alibaba Qwen, Z.ai GLM ZCode, MiniMax, Cursor, Perplexity, DeepSeek and 30+ others. Updated daily.

classification.analysis: Comprehensive public archive of leaked and extracted system prompts from major AI platforms: Anthropic (Claude, Claude Code, Claude Design, Claude Science), OpenAI (ChatGPT, Codex), Google (Gemini), xAI (Grok), and others. Prompts captured verbatim and organized by provider and product. Updated regularly (daily/weekly); used by Washington Post and research organizations for AI transparency analysis and prompt engineering study.

use_cases.title: Study system prompt structure and patterns across different AI models
Understand hidden rules and capabilities of Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini before using them
Reverse-engineer AI behavior and decision-making constraints from official prompts
Train prompt engineers on real-world system prompt design and formatting
Track prompt changes and model updates across Anthropic Claude releases
